title: Three Terms and One Short Page
subtitle: 教育指导 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 教育指导（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：教育指导（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：guidance　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 guidance 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1975 the adviser ① offered the guidance that no student in the room would have described, and he said the offering was the whole of the term. The ② guidance, meaning the advice itself and not the leaflet, ran three terms and stayed undescribed in the book; guidance, he said, is the only thing in a room that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ kind of guidance in that room had the same short page beside it, and the ④ guidance at the far shelf, meaning the notes they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Guidance, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the adviser said the describing is the part that fills three terms.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the guidance was the whole of the matter, meaning the direction and not the advice. The ⑥ guidance, meaning the direction and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; guidance, he said, is either something you offer or the only word that means both an advice and a direction. He said the direction is the part they remember.

By 1980 the ⑦ guidance had become a line in a handbook, and the handbook had become an argument about the short page. The ⑧ guidance of the whole thing, the adviser wrote in November, was one room and three terms of describing; guidance, he said, is either the notes at the far shelf or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ guidance I remember is the guidance described in the handbook, which closed in 1982 and is still described as the quietest in the room. ⑩ Guidance, my mother said in 1984, is the only advice that improves by being described; all guidance, she said, is a direction that has agreed to look like advice. She said the direction was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 指导；引导（指房间里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 指导；引导（指那些建议本身，与传单相对）
C. 固定搭配：offer the guidance 提供指导
D. n. 指导（指留给孩子们看的那些笔记）
E. n. 指导（抽象总称，指一间房间的指导之事）
F. n. 指导（指手册里写到、被记下的那些）
G. n. 方向；指引（指一件事里人人都求却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 指引（抽象总称，指人人都求却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: offered the guidance that no student in the room would have described
The guidance, meaning the advice itself and not the leaflet
Every kind of guidance in that room
the guidance at the far shelf
the guidance was the whole of the matter
the guidance had become a line in a handbook
The guidance of the whole thing

answers.why: offer the guidance 意为“提供指导”，1975 年那位顾问提供了房间里没有一位学生肯描述的建议。
guidance 意为“指导、引导”，指那些建议本身而不是传单，它经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被描述。
guidance 意为“指导、引导”，指房间里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一页矮矮的纸。
guidance 意为“指导”，指最远那层架上留给孩子们看的那些笔记，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
guidance 意为“方向、指引”，指一件事里人人都求却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份指引就是那件事的全部。
guidance 意为“指引”，指人人都求却无人提起的那样东西而不是那些建议，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
guidance 意为“指导”，指手册里写到、被记下的那些，到 1980 年这些成了手册里的一行。
guidance 意为“指导”，顾问十一月写道，整件事的指导之事是一间房间和三个学期的描述。
guidance 意为“指导”，我记得的是手册里描述过的那些，1982 年印好了，至今仍被说成房间里最安静的一批。
guidance 为抽象总称，母亲 1984 年说，指导是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的建议。
